🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Meeting at Rotary Club of Rojas Argentina

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
Rotary Club of Rojas | District 4895, Argentina
President: David Costanzi | Secretary: Andrea Lopez

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, the delegation of Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, attended a warm and engaging Rotary meeting with Rotary Club of Rojas, District 4895, Argentina. There were 10 Interactors also present and they announced their projects.

The meeting commenced with warm greetings and a gracious welcome to the visiting Indian delegation. The distinguished invitees were formally recognised, followed by the opening remarks by President David Costanzi, who welcomed the delegation and highlighted the importance of Rotary fellowship and international friendship.

Dr. Kamalini Pathak, India Team Leader, addressed the gathering and shared her thoughts on the RFE experience and the strong bonds being created between the two Rotary districts.

Rtn. Atul Pathak presented an engaging glimpse into Indian culture, sharing the richness and diversity of India's traditions and heritage with the Argentine Rotarians.

Malvika Sukhani, District 3141, also addressed the gathering, further strengthening the exchange of ideas and experiences between the two Rotary communities.

A special Flag Exchange Ceremony 🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 was conducted, symbolising friendship, goodwill and the growing relationship between District 3141 and District 4895.

The meeting concluded with a warm Vote of Thanks by Namrata N, expressing gratitude to the President, Secretary and members of Rotary Club of Rojas for their gracious hospitality and memorable fellowship.

Two Districts • Two Countries • One Rotary Family

A truly enriching Rotary meeting that celebrated culture, fellowship, international understanding and friendships that transcend borders.

District 3141 • India
